g.text: NetBox: the queryable view of the lab
Git is the spec. Terraform writes NetBox; people mostly read it. Internal only: topology is recon gold.
held on the 4.6 line until the Terraform provider supports 4.7
K8s workloads are not in NetBox:
it is IPAM / DCIM, not cluster state.
Sources: docs/services/netbox.md, docs/known-issues/netbox.md. Media and reports stay on emptyDir; the chart shares one RWO volume between pods.
